primary_failure_mode_caught: Unsupported promotion of candidate claims into findings or scores.

assumptions.posture: Reads each claim against its accepted upstream citations only and keeps a candidate a candidate until the stage's evidence rule is met.

required_inputs: 09 review shard with its upstream, red and blue citations
outputs: disposition, method and proof-obligation status for each reviewed item, with the evidence items it rests on
must_not: promote a claim on a citation it did not check
